title: Resting-state fMRI functional connectivity -> autism / ADHD

autism_abide.note: ABIDE I Preprocessed (CPAC), ~1,035 subjects (505 autism / 530 typically developing) from 20 sites. Published subject-independent accuracies ~67-70% (Abraham 2017; Heinsfeld 2018); tangent-space connectivity + linear classifier was the strongest classic pipeline.

adhd_adhd200.note: ADHD-200 Preprocessed (Athena pipeline), ~900 children/adolescents (ADHD of any subtype vs typically developing controls) from 8 sites. The 2011 competition's best imaging-based accuracy was ~61% (3-way); ADHD is harder than autism from rs-fMRI.
